Adopted the pacer brief for #4257 (lane haiku). Added three unique technology lines to game/data/train.jsonl (KAMANDARAN, FORCED_LEVY, SILK_ROAD) with the key costs. Kamandaran and Forced Levy use factors (x2.0 wood, x0.0 gold; x1.4 food, x0.0 gold) so that the ticket stays data-only: the int values would have needed civs form test changes. Verified with ruff, data files, tech effect and cost tests, and data_lint. PR #4415 opened; Automerge takes it when quick CI is green. Next: nothing ready on the haiku lane.
